answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 34937 Country: India Title: I want to get married to any pious girl as soon as possible. I talked my parents regarding this Question: I want to get married to any pious girl as soon as possible. I talked my parents regarding this. They said wait for 2 years, you complete your education and we will make it done as soon as possible. But I am in severe need of getting married. I want it to be done in just recent few months. I do not know how it is possible but I want it to be done. I am currently 19 years old. As you are aware of the environment around, it is very difficult for me to carry myself in such drastic atmosphere. Bas ye ek hi takleef hai mujhe. plz let me know some strong dua or wazifah. Mera bahaut bura haal hai. Sins get committed by me when I used to be alone at home. Currently I used to pray every salah by jamah, perform every sunnah and nafl thereafter, perform 4 rakah Ishraq daily, 2 rakah salatul Haajah daily, 2 rakah salatut Taubah (if required) and used to sit in Masjid from Asar till Maghrib salah daily and perform 6 rakah awwabin (if being free after Maghrib). Please say what should more I do to make marriage matter come closer? Answer ID: 34937 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1838/D=405/File_D=1432) Read the following dua extensively: اللهم انى اسئلك الهدى والتقى والعفاف والغنى . It is good to regard nafl and mustahab in moderate way. Now you are only 19 years old. After marriage there would be some responsibilities towards your wife that may be hindrance for your education. Hence your parents are making delay for your good. You should avoid living alone in privacy so that you could save yourself from Satan. Keep yourself busy in any work and keep on doing zikr or reading durood. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
